title: Use invite-code endpoint in JoinBlockCubit flow
objective: Add a typed invite-code lookup path and refactor JoinBlockCubit away from getAllAsync plus client-side inviteCode filtering.
acceptance_criteria: CarnivalBlocksApiClient implements getByInviteCodeAsync with explicit route handling or a clear backend TODO Failure if the route is unavailable
CarnivalBlocksRepository delegates getByInviteCodeAsync to the API client
JoinBlockCubit calls getByInviteCodeAsync exactly once for the submitted invite code
JoinBlockCubit no longer calls _carnivalBlocksRepository.getAllAsync for invite-code lookup
JoinBlockCubit preserves current-user lookup, role-0 join creation, success state, and error state semantics
flutter analyze for carnivalBlocks repository/API and joinBlock cubit reports no new errors
deliverables: Updated carnival blocks API client interface and implementation
Updated carnival blocks repository interface and implementation
